## Overview

This analysis claims we could save millions of lives by redirecting 1% of military spending to medical research. Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence. Here's how we calculated it. Every assumption exposed, every source cited, every formula shown. Verify it yourself.

**Total parameters**: 390

- External sources (peer-reviewed): 149
- Calculated values: 138
- Core definitions: 103

### Additional Drug Approvals from Cost Elimination: 20 drugs/year {#sec-additional_drugs_from_cost_elimination}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Additional drug approvals per year when Phase 2/3 cost barrier eliminated. Assumes valley-of-death compounds (abandoned due to cost) would have similar success rate to funded compounds.

**Inputs**:

- [Average Annual New Drug Approvals Globally](#sec-current_drug_approvals_per_year) 📊: 50 drugs/year (95% CI: 45 drugs/year - 60 drugs/year)
- [Valley of Death Attrition Rate](#sec-valley_of_death_attrition_pct) 📊: 40% (95% CI: 25% - 55%)

$$
Cost = Drug_{current} \times Deaths = 50 \times 40\% = 20
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

### Clinical Trial Cost Per Approved Drug: $1.20B {#sec-clinical_trial_cost_per_approved_drug}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Annual clinical trial spending per approved drug (trials only, excluding other R&D costs like discovery, preclinical, manufacturing). Note: $60B ÷ 50 drugs = $1.2B per drug.

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Global Spending on Clinical Trials](#sec-global_clinical_trials_spending_annual) 📊: $60B (95% CI: $50B - $75B)
- [Average Annual New Drug Approvals Globally](#sec-current_drug_approvals_per_year) 📊: 50 drugs/year (95% CI: 45 drugs/year - 60 drugs/year)

$$
\begin{aligned}
Cost \\
&= \frac{Trials_{ann}}{Drug_{current}} \\
&= \frac{\$60B}{50} \\
&= \$1.2B
\end{aligned}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Annual Cost Per Clinical Trial Participant: $31.6K {#sec-clinical_trial_cost_per_participant_annual}

### Combined Peace and Health Dividends for ROI Calculation: $172B {#sec-combined_peace_health_dividends_annual_for_roi_calc}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Combined peace and health dividends for ROI calculation

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Peace Dividend from 1% Reduction in Total War Costs](#sec-peace_dividend_annual_societal_benefit) 🔢: $114B
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings](#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual) 🔢: $58.6B

$$
\begin{aligned}
Dividend_{ann} = Cost_{soc,ann} + Benefit_{DFDA,ann} = \$114B + \$58.6B = \$172B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{soc,ann} = Cost_{indirect,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$11.4T \times 1\% = \$114B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,ann} = Cost_{direct,total} + Cost_{indirect,total} = \$7.66T + \$3.7T = \$11.4T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{direct,total} = Loss_{human,ann} + Infrastructure_{global} + Disruption_{trade,ann} + Spending_{mil,ann} = \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T = \$7.66T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{human,ann} = Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} = \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B = \$2.45T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{combat,ann} \times Value = 234{,}000 \times \$10M = \$2.34T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{ann} \times Value = 2{,}700 \times \$10M = \$27B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{terror,ann} \times Value = 8{,}300 \times \$10M = \$83B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Infrastructure_{global} = Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} = \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B = \$1.88T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade,ann} = Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} = \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B = \$616B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,total} = Cost_{env,ann} + Cost_{mil,ann} + Lost_{global} + Cost_{ann} + Cost_{ref,ann} + Cost_{vet,ann} = \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B = \$3.7T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{DFDA,ann} = Trials_{ann} \times Reduction_{DFDA} = \$60B \times 97.7\% = \$58.6B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduction_{DFDA} = 1 - (DFDA_COST / TRADITIONAL_COST) = 97.7\%
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/peace-dividend-calculations#peace-dividend-composition](../appendix/peace-dividend-calculations#peace-dividend-composition)

*✓ High confidence*

Total annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment operational costs (sum of all components: $15M + $10M + $8M + $5M + $2M)

- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Maintenance Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_platform_maintenance): $15M (95% CI: $10M - $22M)

### dFDA Combined Treatment Discovery Speedup Multiplier: 17.2x {#sec-dfda_combined_treatment_speedup_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Combined speedup factor for treatment discovery from dFDA. Trial capacity multiplier times valley of death rescue multiplier. Diseases that would take T years to get first treatment now take T/speedup years.

**Inputs**:

- [Trial Capacity Multiplier](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier) 🔢: 12.3:1
- [dFDA Valley of Death Rescue Multiplier](#sec-dfda_valley_of_death_rescue_multiplier) 🔢: 1.4x

$$
\begin{aligned}
Multiplier_{DFDA} = Multiplier_{DFDA} \times Multiplier_{DFDA} = 12.3 \times 1.4 = 17.2
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = Deaths + 1 = 40\% + 1 = 1.4
\end{aligned}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### Direct Funding ROI - Full Timeline Shift: 178k:1 {#sec-dfda_direct_funding_roi_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

ROI from direct philanthropic/government funding of medical research (vs treaty campaign). Same benefits as treaty but costs $541.9B NPV instead of $1B campaign. Still excellent ROI, but treaty campaign achieves 542× better leverage.

**Inputs**:

- [Total Economic Value from Full Timeline Shift](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_economic_value) 🔢: $84.8 quadrillion
- [dFDA Direct Funding NPV (Queue Clearance Period)](#sec-dfda_direct_funding_queue_clearance_npv): $475B

$$
\begin{aligned}
Funding_{direct,DFDA} = \frac{Capacity_{DFDA}}{Funding_{direct,DFDA}} = \frac{\$84800T}{\$475B} = 178{,}000
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Capacity_{DFDA} = DALYs_{DFDA} \times QALYs_{RD} = 565B \times \$150K = \$84800T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{DFDA} = DALYs_{ann} \times DALYs \times Capacity_{DFDA} = 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 = 565B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Capacity_{DFDA} = Ratio_{DFDA} + Delay = 204 + 8.2 = 212
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Ratio_{DFDA} = STATUS_QUO_AVG_YEARS_TO_FIRST_TREATMENT \times (1 - 1/DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_MULTIPLIER) = 204
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Status = Time \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Time = \frac{Diseases}{New} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Diseases = Rare_{global} + -1 = 7{,}000 + -1 = 6{,}650
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{direct,DFDA} = ANNUAL_FUNDING \times [(1 - (1 + r)^-T) / r] where T = queue clearance time = \$475B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]

- [Years Lived with Disability During Disease Eradication Delay](#sec-dfda_efficacy_lag_elimination_yld) 🔢: 873M years

$$
\begin{aligned}

\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{DFDA} = ANNUAL_DEATHS \times EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS \times EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT = 416M
\\[0.5em]

\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{DFDA} = ANNUAL_DEATHS \times EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS \times EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT = 416M

\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{DFDA} = ANNUAL_DEATHS \times EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS \times EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT = 416M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Delay_{DFDA} = Deaths_{DFDA} \times Deaths \times Chronic = 416M \times 6 \times 0.35 = 873M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{DFDA} = ANNUAL_DEATHS \times EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS \times EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT = 416M
\end{aligned}
$$

### dFDA Queue Clearance Time: 36 years {#sec-dfda_queue_clearance_years}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Years to treat all currently untreatable diseases with dFDA implementation. Queue clearance time divided by trial capacity multiplier.

**Inputs**:

- [Status Quo Queue Clearance Time](#sec-status_quo_queue_clearance_years) 🔢: 443 years
- [Trial Capacity Multiplier](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier) 🔢: 12.3:1

$$
\begin{aligned}
Time_{DFDA} = \frac{Time}{Multiplier_{DFDA}} = \frac{443}{12.3} = 36
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Time = \frac{Diseases}{New} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Diseases = Rare_{global} + -1 = 7{,}000 + -1 = 6{,}650
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\end{aligned}
$$

*? Low confidence*

### DALYs Averted from Trial Capacity Increase: 543B DALYs {#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_dalys_averted}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Total DALYs averted from trial capacity increase alone. Calculated as annual global DALY burden × eventually avoidable percentage × treatment acceleration years. Includes both fatal and non-fatal diseases.

**Inputs**:

- [Global Annual DALY Burden](#sec-global_annual_daly_burden) 📊: 2.88B DALYs/year (SE: ±150M DALYs/year)

- [dFDA Treatment Timeline Acceleration](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_treatment_acceleration_years) 🔢: 204 years

\\[0.5em]

\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Status = Time \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222
\\[0.5em]

\\[0.5em]

\\[0.5em]

\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M

### Suffering Hours Eliminated from Full Timeline Shift: 1931T hours {#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_suffering_hours}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Hours of suffering eliminated from the combined dFDA timeline shift. Calculated from YLD component of DALYs (39% of total DALYs × hours per year). One-time benefit, not annual recurring.

**Inputs**:

- [Total DALYs from Full Timeline Shift](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_dalys) 🔢: 565B DALYs
- [YLD Proportion of Total DALYs](#sec-global_yld_proportion_of_dalys) 📊: 0.39 proportion (SE: ±0.03 proportion)

$$
\begin{aligned}
Capacity_{DFDA} = DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG_DALYS \times GLOBAL_YLD_PROPORTION \times HOURS_PER_YEAR = 1930T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{DFDA} = DALYs_{ann} \times DALYs \times Capacity_{DFDA} = 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 = 565B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Capacity_{DFDA} = Ratio_{DFDA} + Delay = 204 + 8.2 = 212
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Ratio_{DFDA} = STATUS_QUO_AVG_YEARS_TO_FIRST_TREATMENT \times (1 - 1/DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_MULTIPLIER) = 204
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Status = Time \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Time = \frac{Diseases}{New} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Diseases = Rare_{global} + -1 = 7{,}000 + -1 = 6{,}650
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/regulatory-mortality-analysis#daly-calculation](../appendix/regulatory-mortality-analysis#daly-calculation)

### dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Factor: 44.1x {#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_factor}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Cost reduction factor projected for dFDA pragmatic trials ($41K traditional / $1,200 dFDA = 34x)

**Inputs**:

- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)
- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)

$$

Cost_{DFDA} \\
&= \frac{Cost}{Cost_{DFDA}} \\
&= \frac{\$41K}{\$929} \\
&= 44.1

### dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Percentage: 97.7% {#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_pct}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Trial cost reduction percentage: (traditional - dFDA) / traditional = ($41K - $1.2K) / $41K = 97%

**Inputs**:

- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)
- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)

$$
\begin{aligned}
Reduction_{DFDA} \\
&= 1 - (DFDA_COST / TRADITIONAL_COST) \\
&= 97.7\%

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Drug development cost increase from pre-1962 to current ($24.7M → $2.6B = 105×)

**Inputs**:

- [Pharma Drug Development Cost (Current System)](#sec-pharma_drug_development_cost_current) 📊: $2.60B (95% CI: $1.50B - $4B)
- [Pre-1962 Drug Development Cost (2024 Dollars)](#sec-pre_1962_drug_development_cost_2024_usd) 📊: $24.7M (95% CI: $19.5M - $30M)

$$
\begin{aligned}
Multiplier_{curr} \\
&= \frac{Cost_{curr}}{Cost_{pre62}} \\
&= \frac{\$2.6B}{\$24.7M} \\
&= 105
\end{aligned}
$$

\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{ann} \times Value = 2{,}700 \times \$10M = \$27B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{terror,ann} \times Value = 8{,}300 \times \$10M = \$83B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Infrastructure_{global} = Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} = \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B = \$1.88T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade,ann} = Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} = \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B = \$616B
\\[0.5em]

### Misallocation Factor: Cost to Kill vs Cost to Save: 2.89k:1 {#sec-misallocation_factor_death_vs_saving}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Misallocation factor: cost to kill vs cost to save

**Inputs**:

- [Total Annual Conflict Deaths Globally](#sec-global_annual_conflict_deaths_total) 🔢: 245k deaths/year
- [Total Annual Cost of War Worldwide](#sec-global_annual_direct_indirect_war_cost) 🔢: $11.4T
- [Cost per Life Saved by Medical Research](#sec-global_cost_per_life_saved_med_research_annual) 🔢: $16.1K

$$
\begin{aligned}
Cost = COST_PER_DEATH \div COST_PER_LIFE_SAVED = 2{,}890
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{total} = Deaths_{combat,ann} + Deaths_{ann} + Deaths_{terror,ann} = 234{,}000 + 2{,}700 + 8{,}300 = 245{,}000
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,ann} = Cost_{direct,total} + Cost_{indirect,total} = \$7.66T + \$3.7T = \$11.4T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{direct,total} = Loss_{human,ann} + Infrastructure_{global} + Disruption_{trade,ann} + Spending_{mil,ann} = \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T = \$7.66T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{human,ann} = Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} = \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B = \$2.45T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{combat,ann} \times Value = 234{,}000 \times \$10M = \$2.34T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{ann} \times Value = 2{,}700 \times \$10M = \$27B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{terror,ann} \times Value = 8{,}300 \times \$10M = \$83B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Infrastructure_{global} = Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} = \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B = \$1.88T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade,ann} = Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} = \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B = \$616B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,total} = Cost_{env,ann} + Cost_{mil,ann} + Lost_{global} + Cost_{ann} + Cost_{ref,ann} + Cost_{vet,ann} = \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B = \$3.7T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{ann} = \frac{Spending_{global}}{Lives_{ann}} = \frac{\$67.5B}{4.2M} = \$16.1K
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../problem/cost-of-war#grotesque-mathematics](../problem/cost-of-war#grotesque-mathematics)

*✓ High confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### Personal Lifetime Wealth (Age 30, 1% Treaty): $494K {#sec-personal_lifetime_wealth}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Personal lifetime wealth benefit for a 30-year-old with $50K income under 1% treaty. Life extension uncertainty (5-50 years) propagates through Monte Carlo to show full range of outcomes from conservative antibiotic precedent to optimistic aging reversal scenarios.

**Inputs**:

- [Life Extension from Treaty Research Acceleration](#sec-life_extension_years) 📊: 20 years (95% CI: 5 years - 100 years)
- [Trial Capacity Multiplier](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier) 🔢: 12.3:1

$$
\begin{aligned}
Time = NPV(peace_dividend + healthcare_savings + productivity_gains + caregiver_savings + gdp_boost + extended_earnings) = \$494K
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/disease-eradication-personal-lifetime-wealth-calculations](../appendix/disease-eradication-personal-lifetime-wealth-calculations)

### Pragmatic Trial Cost per QALY (RECOVERY): $4.00 {#sec-pragmatic_trial_cost_per_qaly}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Cost per QALY for pragmatic platform trials, calculated from RECOVERY trial data. Uses global impact methodology: trial cost divided by total QALYs from downstream adoption. This measures research efficiency (discovery value), not clinical intervention ICER.

**Inputs**:

- [RECOVERY Trial Total Cost](#sec-recovery_trial_total_cost) 📊: $20M (95% CI: $15M - $25M)
- [RECOVERY Trial Total QALYs Generated](#sec-recovery_trial_total_qalys_generated) 🔢: 5.00M QALYs

$$
\begin{aligned}
Cost = \frac{Cost_{total}}{Rate_{total}} = \frac{\$20M}{5M} = \$4
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Rate_{total} = Trials_{global} \times Deaths = 1M \times 5 = 5M
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [Manhattan Institute - RECOVERY trial 82× cost reduction](../references.qmd#recovery-trial-82x-cost-reduction)

*~ Medium confidence*

### Pragmatic Trial Efficiency Multiplier vs NIH: 12.5k:1 {#sec-pragmatic_vs_nih_efficiency_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

How many times more cost-effective pragmatic trials are vs standard NIH research. Calculated using global impact methodology (NIH cost per QALY / pragmatic cost per QALY). Shows orders-of-magnitude efficiency gap between discovery-focused pragmatic trials and standard research.

**Inputs**:

- [NIH Standard Research Cost per QALY](#sec-nih_standard_research_cost_per_qaly) 📊: $50K (95% CI: $20K - $100K)
- [Pragmatic Trial Cost per QALY (RECOVERY)](#sec-pragmatic_trial_cost_per_qaly) 🔢: $4.00

$$
\begin{aligned}
Multiplier = \frac{Cost_{RD}}{Cost} = \frac{\$50K}{\$4} = 12{,}500
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost = \frac{Cost_{total}}{Rate_{total}} = \frac{\$20M}{5M} = \$4
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Rate_{total} = Trials_{global} \times Deaths = 1M \times 5 = 5M
\end{aligned}
$$

### Status Quo Average Years to First Treatment: 222 years {#sec-status_quo_avg_years_to_first_treatment}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Average years until first treatment discovered for a typical disease under current system. The average disease is in the middle of the queue, so it waits half the total queue clearance time (~443/2 = ~222 years).

**Inputs**:

- [Status Quo Queue Clearance Time](#sec-status_quo_queue_clearance_years) 🔢: 443 years

$$
\begin{aligned}
Status = Time \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Time = \frac{Diseases}{New} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Diseases = Rare_{global} + -1 = 7{,}000 + -1 = 6{,}650
\end{aligned}
$$

### Treaty System Benefit Multiplier vs Childhood Vaccination Programs: 11.5:1 {#sec-treaty_benefit_multiplier_vs_vaccines}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Treaty system benefit multiplier vs childhood vaccination programs

**Inputs**:

- [Estimated Annual Global Economic Benefit from Childhood Vaccination Programs](#sec-childhood_vaccination_annual_benefit) 📊: $15B (SE: ±$4.50B)
- [Combined Peace and Health Dividends for ROI Calculation](#sec-combined_peace_health_dividends_annual_for_roi_calc) 🔢: $172B

$$
\begin{aligned}
Multiplier_{treaty} = \frac{Dividend_{ann}}{Benefit_{ann}} = \frac{\$172B}{\$15B} = 11.5
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Dividend_{ann} = Cost_{soc,ann} + Benefit_{DFDA,ann} = \$114B + \$58.6B = \$172B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{soc,ann} = Cost_{indirect,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$11.4T \times 1\% = \$114B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,ann} = Cost_{direct,total} + Cost_{indirect,total} = \$7.66T + \$3.7T = \$11.4T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{direct,total} = Loss_{human,ann} + Infrastructure_{global} + Disruption_{trade,ann} + Spending_{mil,ann} = \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T = \$7.66T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{human,ann} = Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} = \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B = \$2.45T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{combat,ann} \times Value = 234{,}000 \times \$10M = \$2.34T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{ann} \times Value = 2{,}700 \times \$10M = \$27B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{terror,ann} \times Value = 8{,}300 \times \$10M = \$83B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Infrastructure_{global} = Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} = \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B = \$1.88T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade,ann} = Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} = \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B = \$616B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,total} = Cost_{env,ann} + Cost_{mil,ann} + Lost_{global} + Cost_{ann} + Cost_{ref,ann} + Cost_{vet,ann} = \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B = \$3.7T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{DFDA,ann} = Trials_{ann} \times Reduction_{DFDA} = \$60B \times 97.7\% = \$58.6B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduction_{DFDA} = 1 - (DFDA_COST / TRADITIONAL_COST) = 97.7\%
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../economics/economics#better-than-the-best-charities](../economics/economics#better-than-the-best-charities)

### Cost per DALY Averted (Timeline Shift): $0.0018 {#sec-treaty_cost_per_daly_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Cost per DALY averted from full timeline shift (trial capacity acceleration + efficacy lag elimination). Only counts campaign cost; ignores economic benefits from funding and R&D savings.

**Inputs**:

- [Total 1% Treaty Campaign Cost](#sec-treaty_campaign_total_cost) 🔢: $1B
- [Total DALYs from Full Timeline Shift](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_dalys) 🔢: 565B DALYs

$$
\begin{aligned}
Cost_{treaty} = \frac{Cost_{camp,total}}{DALYs_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$1B}{565B} = \$0.00177
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{camp,total} = Campaign_{camp,treaty} + Campaign_{camp,treaty} + Campaign_{camp,treaty} = \$250M + \$650M + \$100M = \$1B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{DFDA} = DALYs_{ann} \times DALYs \times Capacity_{DFDA} = 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 = 565B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Capacity_{DFDA} = Ratio_{DFDA} + Delay = 204 + 8.2 = 212
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Ratio_{DFDA} = STATUS_QUO_AVG_YEARS_TO_FIRST_TREATMENT \times (1 - 1/DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_MULTIPLIER) = 204
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Status = Time \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Time = \frac{Diseases}{New} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Diseases = Rare_{global} + -1 = 7{,}000 + -1 = 6{,}650
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-cost-benefit-analysis](../appendix/dfda-cost-benefit-analysis)

*✓ High confidence*

\text{where } Diseases = Rare_{global} + -1 = 7{,}000 + -1 = 6{,}650
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Multiplier_{DFDA} = \frac{Fundable_{ann}}{Trials_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Fundable_{ann} = \frac{Treasury_{ann}}{Cost_{DFDA}} = \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} = 23.4M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\end{aligned}

### 1% treaty Basic Annual Benefits (Peace + R&D Savings): $172B {#sec-treaty_peace_plus_rd_annual_benefits}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Basic annual benefits: peace dividend + Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment R&D savings only (2 of 8 benefit categories, excludes regulatory delay value)

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Peace Dividend from 1% Reduction in Total War Costs](#sec-peace_dividend_annual_societal_benefit) 🔢: $114B
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings](#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual) 🔢: $58.6B

$$
\begin{aligned}
Benefit_{ann} = Cost_{soc,ann} + Benefit_{DFDA,ann} = \$114B + \$58.6B = \$172B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{soc,ann} = Cost_{indirect,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$11.4T \times 1\% = \$114B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,ann} = Cost_{direct,total} + Cost_{indirect,total} = \$7.66T + \$3.7T = \$11.4T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{direct,total} = Loss_{human,ann} + Infrastructure_{global} + Disruption_{trade,ann} + Spending_{mil,ann} = \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T = \$7.66T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{human,ann} = Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} + Cost_{human,ann} = \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B = \$2.45T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{combat,ann} \times Value = 234{,}000 \times \$10M = \$2.34T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{ann} \times Value = 2{,}700 \times \$10M = \$27B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{human,ann} = Deaths_{terror,ann} \times Value = 8{,}300 \times \$10M = \$83B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Infrastructure_{global} = Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} + Damage_{infra,ann} = \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B = \$1.88T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade,ann} = Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} + Cost_{trade,ann} = \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B = \$616B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{indirect,total} = Cost_{env,ann} + Cost_{mil,ann} + Lost_{global} + Cost_{ann} + Cost_{ref,ann} + Cost_{vet,ann} = \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B = \$3.7T
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{DFDA,ann} = Trials_{ann} \times Reduction_{DFDA} = \$60B \times 97.7\% = \$58.6B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduction_{DFDA} = 1 - (DFDA_COST / TRADITIONAL_COST) = 97.7\%
\end{aligned}
$$

\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = Treasury_{ann} - Cost_{DFDA,ann} = \$21.8B - \$40M = \$21.7B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{DFDA,ann} = Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{infra,DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} + Cost_{DFDA} = \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M = \$40M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{ann} = TREATY_FUNDING - BOND_PAYOUT - IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING = \$21.8B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Victory_{annual} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Funding_{ann} \times Funding = \$27.2B \times 10\% = \$2.72B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{ann} = Spending_{mil,ann} \times Reduction_{treaty} = \$2.72T \times 1\% = \$27.2B
\end{aligned}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Ratio of Type Ii Error Cost to Type I Error Benefit: 3.07k:1 {#sec-type_ii_error_cost_ratio}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Ratio of Type II error cost to Type I error benefit (harm from delay vs. harm prevented)

**Inputs**:

- [Total DALYs Lost from Disease Eradication Delay](#sec-dfda_efficacy_lag_elimination_dalys) 🔢: 7.94B DALYs
- [Maximum DALYs Saved by FDA Preventing Unsafe Drugs (1962-2024)](#sec-type_i_error_benefit_dalys) 🔢: 2.59M DALYs

$$
\begin{aligned}
Cost = \frac{DALYs_{DFDA}}{DALYs} = \frac{7.94B}{2.59M} = 3{,}070
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{DFDA} = Delay_{DFDA} + Delay_{DFDA} = 7.07B + 873M = 7.94B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Delay_{DFDA} = DEATHS_TOTAL \times (LIFE_EXPECTANCY - MEAN_AGE_OF_DEATH) = 7.07B
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{DFDA} = ANNUAL_DEATHS \times EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS \times EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT = 416M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Delay_{DFDA} = Deaths_{DFDA} \times Deaths \times Chronic = 416M \times 6 \times 0.35 = 873M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{DFDA} = ANNUAL_DEATHS \times EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS \times EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT = 416M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs = DALYs \times 62 = 41{,}800 \times 62 = 2.59M
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs = YLD + YLL = 13{,}000 + 28{,}800 = 41{,}800
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLD = Thalidomide \times Thalidomide \times Thalidomide = 0.4 \times 540 \times 60 = 13{,}000
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Thalidomide = US_CASES \times (1 - MORTALITY_RATE) = 540
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } ThalidomideUS = Thalidomide \times Population = 15{,}000 \times 6\% = 900
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLL = Deaths \times 80 = 360 \times 80 = 28{,}800
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths = Rate \times ThalidomideUS = 40\% \times 900 = 360
\\[0.5em]
\text{where } ThalidomideUS = Thalidomide \times Population = 15{,}000 \times 6\% = 900
\end{aligned}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/regulatory-mortality-analysis#risk-analysis](../appendix/regulatory-mortality-analysis#risk-analysis)

*~ Medium confidence*

### Bed Nets Cost per DALY: $89 {#sec-bed_nets_cost_per_daly}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

GiveWell cost per DALY for insecticide-treated bed nets (midpoint estimate, range $78-100). DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years) measure disease burden by combining years of life lost and years lived with disability. Bed nets prevent malaria deaths and are considered a gold standard benchmark for cost-effective global health interventions - if an intervention costs less per DALY than bed nets, it's exceptionally cost-effective. GiveWell synthesizes peer-reviewed academic research with transparent, rigorous methodology and extensive external expert review.

**Source**: [GiveWell - GiveWell Cost per Life Saved for Top Charities (2024)](../references.qmd#givewell-cost-per-life-saved)

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$78, $100] • Distribution: Normal

**What this means**: This estimate has moderate uncertainty. The true value likely falls between $78 and $100 (±12%). This represents a reasonable range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The normal distribution means values cluster around the center with equal chances of being higher or lower.*

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-bed_nets_cost_per_daly.qmd >}}

*✓ High confidence • 📊 Peer-reviewed*

### dFDA Direct Funding Cost per DALY: $0.841 {#sec-dfda_direct_funding_cost_per_daly}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

Cost per DALY if philanthropists/governments directly funded $21.76B/year for ~46.5 years (queue clearance period, NPV: ~$541.9B) instead of treaty campaign ($1B). Treaty achieves 542× leverage: $1B campaign unlocks government funding for 46.5 years (NPV: $541.9B), avoiding direct philanthropic commitment. Both achieve same 200B DALY timeline shift benefit. Still cost-effective vs bed nets ($89.0/DALY).

*Core definition*

:::

### dFDA Direct Funding NPV (Queue Clearance Period): $475B {#sec-dfda_direct_funding_queue_clearance_npv}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Show full details"}

NPV of direct funding ($21.76B/year for medical research after bond/IAB allocations) for the ~46.5-year queue clearance period. Alternative scenario: instead of $1B treaty campaign to unlock government funding, philanthropists/NIH directly fund clinical trials until disease queue is cleared. Funding period is queue clearance time (46.5 years with 9.5× trial capacity), not timeline shift amount (207 years). After queue is cleared, the timeline shift benefit (200B DALYs) is fully realized.

*Core definition*

:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
```
